proof_cost.scope: Only the winning final certificate or the retained best partial proof; not peak search memory

branch_ranker.features_scope: All ordered native goal texts and prefix depth; unobserved per-branch costs/budgets stay missing

model_advice_memory.previous_model_call_unit: One-based actual forward-pass batch count, not provider decode-attempt ordinal.

attempt_memory.scope: One search; exact full ordered goal tuple, including all context and names.
attempt_memory.pruning: Heuristic; repeated equal/deeper prefixes may be skipped. No completeness claim.
attempt_memory.retained_bytes_unit: UTF-8 JSON goal payload; excludes Python object overhead and small metadata.
